title: ReadyMedia (formerly MiniDLNA) versions 1.3.0 through 1.3.3 contain a stack-based buffer overflow vulnerability that…
description: ReadyMedia (formerly MiniDLNA) versions 1.3.0 through 1.3.3 have a stack-based buffer overflow vulnerability triggered by a crafted DFF audio file with an oversized PROP chunk size. This flaw allows remote attackers to corrupt stack memory and potentially execute code or cause denial of service when the file is automatically parsed by ReadyMedia's inotify monitoring.
